idea-plugin.name: CrunchGuard
idea-plugin.description:
CrunchGuard — walk to unlock your IDE.

An always-on engine inside the IDE tracks REAL editor keystrokes and fills the crunch meter while you code. When sustained typing is detected the IDE itself forces a walking break: a QR code appears, your phone counts steps (DeviceMotion pedometer), progress syncs live through the plugin's built-in relay server — no Node.js, no external tools. Completing the walk unlocks the IDE with "Crunch Break Verified! +100 Mana".

Configure it under Settings | Tools | CrunchGuard: disable/enable the forced-break engine without uninstalling, freely set how many seconds of sustained typing trigger a break, and freely set the step target. Every value is editable and applies instantly — no restart needed.

This is the plugin variant of CrunchGuard. The standalone variant (runs in a normal browser with a Node server) lives in the without-plugin folder of the same repository.
